text: Two papers presented at SIGIR 2026: a reproducibility study on document position and context size in RAG, and Beyond Top-e, on simulation-based evaluation for query suggestions.
Our framework for keyphrase generation and filtering with T5 appeared in the International Journal of Computational Intelligence Systems.
Beyond questions: Leveraging ColBERT for keyphrase search published in Information Processing & Management, with Javier Parapar and Craig Macdonald.
New preprint: Who Is the Story About? Protagonist Entity Recognition in News.
Started as associate professor at the Universidade da Coruña.
Defended my PhD, Improving the Search Experience on Complex Search Scenarios, cum laude.
Three-month research visit to the Terrier Group at the University of Glasgow, hosted by Craig Macdonald.
